title: A model document, as the engine answers it (ModelContents)

name.description: the file's name, among the document's files

scale.description: the millimetres one unit of the file is; null for its format's standard

up.description: the axis the file stands up along; null for its format's standard

ModelFile.description: One of a model document's files (FILE).

material.description: the material it is made of, by name

size.description: how long it is along each axis, millimetres: x, y, z

at.description: where its centre stands, millimetres: x, y, z

rotate.description: how far it is turned, degrees about X, then Y, then Z

ModelShapes.Box.description: A box, its sides along the axes before it is turned.

material.description: the material it is made of, by name

length.description: how long it is along Z, millimetres

at.description: where its centre stands, millimetres: x, y, z

rotate.description: how far it is turned, degrees about X, then Y, then Z

ModelShapes.Cylinder.description: Along Z before it is turned.

material.description: the material it is made of, by name

outline.description: its base's corners, each an x and a y, millimetres

height.description: how far its base is raised along Z, millimetres

at.description: where its centre stands, millimetres: x, y, z

rotate.description: how far it is turned, degrees about X, then Y, then Z

ModelShapes.Prism.description: A convex outline of [x, y] corners raised along Z by height from its base, where at sets it.

material.description: the material it is made of, by name

profile.description: its profile from the bottom up, each point a radius and a z, millimetres

from.description: the angle it is swept from, degrees

to.description: the angle it is swept to, degrees

at.description: where its centre stands, millimetres: x, y, z

rotate.description: how far it is turned, degrees about X, then Y, then Z

ModelShapes.Revolved.description: A body turned about Z: its profile, radius and z from the bottom up, swept from and to its angles, degrees.

files.description: the files its body is in, each in its format and convention; none for a model drawn from shapes

shapes.description: the shapes it is drawn from here; none for a model of files

description: What a model document is to the engine: the files its body is in, each in its format and convention, or the shapes it is drawn from here.
